entries.name: ammo
entries.description: returns amount of ammo held for currently selected weapon

entries.name: armor
entries.description: returns current armor value

entries.name: armortype
entries.description: returns current armor type

entries.name: bestammo
entries.description: returns ammo held for the 'best' weapon

entries.name: bestweapon
entries.description: returns name of best weapon in inventory

entries.name: cam_angles
entries.description: returns current camera angles, in format that can be passed to /cam_angles command.

entries.name: cam_angles_pitch
entries.description: returns current camera pitch (vertical angle).

entries.name: cam_angles_roll
entries.description: returns current camera roll (not used).

entries.name: cam_angles_yaw
entries.description: returns current camera yaw (horizontal angle).

entries.name: cam_pos
entries.description: returns current camera position, in format that can be passed to /cam_pos command.

entries.name: cam_pos_x
entries.description: returns one component of current camera position.

entries.name: cam_pos_y
entries.description: returns one component of current camera position.

entries.name: cam_pos_z
entries.description: returns one component of current camera position.

entries.name: cells
entries.description: returns number of cells held, regardless of weapon selected

entries.name: colored_armor
entries.description: returns $armor, surrounded by color codes so it is displayed in &c0b0red&r, &cff0yellow&r, &e00green&r or &cfffwhite&r

entries.name: colored_powerups
entries.description: current powerups held as color-coded full names (quad, pent, ring), concatenated without separator.

entries.name: colored_short_powerups
entries.description: current powerups held as compact color-coded initials (q=quad blue, r=ring yellow, p=pent red); output order is q-r-p. Returns empty string when no powerups held.

entries.name: conheight
entries.description: console (virtual) resolution height in pixels.

entries.name: connectiontype
entries.description: returns the current type of the connection

entries.name: conwidth
entries.description: console (virtual) resolution width in pixels.

entries.name: date
entries.description: returns the current date in the format <day>.<month>.<year>

entries.name: dateiso
entries.description: current local date and time in ISO-adjacent format YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM.

entries.name: deathloc
entries.description: map location name where the player last died, or tp_name_someplace if no death has been recorded this session.

entries.name: demolength
entries.description: returns the expected length of the current demo, in seconds

entries.name: demoname
entries.description: returns the name of the current demo, minus extension

entries.name: demoplayback
entries.description: returns whether or not the client is current watching a demo

entries.name: demotime
entries.description: current demo playback time in seconds (float). Intended for scripted and timed camera movement.

entries.name: droploc
entries.description: returns the name of the location where the last backpack was dropped by the current player.

entries.name: droptime
entries.description: returns the number of seconds since the last backpack was dropped by the current player.

entries.name: gamedir
entries.description:
returns the current gamedir, which is often set when a server is running a mod.
e.g: 'fortress' for Team Fortress mods

entries.name: health
entries.description: the current player's health (0 - 250)

entries.name: lastip
entries.description: IP address or hostname:port of the last server seen in console output, captured by an internal trigger pattern.

entries.name: lastloc
entries.description: location name at time of last death if death occurred within the past 5 seconds; otherwise current location name.

entries.name: lastpowerup
entries.description: powerups last seen on the enemy within the past 5 seconds (e.g. "quad pent"); falls back to the value of tp_name_quad when no recent sighting.

entries.name: latency
entries.description: current network latency in milliseconds, rounded to nearest integer.

entries.name: ledpoint
entries.description: LED color code indicating the type of entity pointed at: red for enemy, green for teammate, yellow for powerup, blue for item.

entries.name: ledstatus
entries.description: LED color code reflecting how many items the player currently needs: green for none, yellow for one, red for two or more.

entries.name: location
entries.description: name of the player's current map location, as defined by the active .loc file.

entries.name: matchname
entries.description: current match name, derived from the active match-format template (e.g. "duel/playerA_vs_playerB - [dm6]"). Returns "No match in progress" when not connected.

entries.name: matchstatus
entries.description: current match state: one of "disconnected", "standby", or "normal".

entries.name: matchtype
entries.description: current match type keyword: one of duel, ffa, 2on2, 3on3, 4on4, tdm, arena, tfduel, tfclanwar, solo, coop, race, empty, unknown. Returns "No match in progress" when not connected.

entries.name: nails
entries.description: returns number of nails held, regardless of weapon selected

entries.name: need
entries.description: separator-delimited list of items the player currently needs based on tp_need_* thresholds (e.g. "armor health rl").

entries.name: ping
entries.description: current network latency in milliseconds, rounded to nearest integer. Alias for $latency.

entries.name: point
entries.description: name of the nearest item or entity the player is pointing at, as used in location-pointing messages; returns tp_name_nothing when the player is flashed.

entries.name: pointatloc
entries.description: pointed-at item name combined with its location, in "name at location" format; bounded by the tp_pointtimeout cvar and returns tp_name_nothing when the player is flashed or the timeout expires.

entries.name: pointloc
entries.description: map location of the entity pointed at, or current location if no specific point location is available; returns tp_name_nothing when the player is flashed.

entries.name: powerups
entries.description: separator-delimited list of powerups currently held (quad, pent, ring, flag for CTF/TF); returns tp_name_none when none held.

entries.name: qt
entries.description: returns " - useful to clear cvars in scripts

entries.name: rand
entries.description: random float in the range [0, 1).

entries.name: rockets
entries.description: returns number of rockets held, regardless of weapon selected

entries.name: serverip
entries.description: current server IP address and port, in ip:port form.

entries.name: shells
entries.description: returns number of shells held, regardless of weapon selected

entries.name: team1
entries.description: name of the Nth team currently playing, alphabetically sorted; $team1 returns the first team, $team2 the second. In FFA (no teamplay), returns player names instead. Falls back to literal "team1"/"team2" when fewer teams exist.

entries.name: team2
entries.description: name of the Nth team currently playing, alphabetically sorted; $team1 returns the first team, $team2 the second. In FFA (no teamplay), returns player names instead. Falls back to literal "team1"/"team2" when fewer teams exist.

entries.name: tf_skin
entries.description: current player's skin name, with TeamFortress skin prefixes expanded to full class names (e.g. tf_demo -> demoman, tf_eng -> engineer).

entries.name: time
entries.description: returns the local time in the format <hours>:<minutes>

entries.name: timestamp
entries.description: current local date and time as a compact filesystem-safe string: YYYYMMDD-HHMM.

entries.name: took
entries.description: name of the last item picked up; returns tp_name_nothing if nothing has been picked up yet.

entries.name: tookatloc
entries.description: last item picked up with its pickup location, in "name at location" format; returns tp_name_nothing when no item has been picked up.

entries.name: tookloc
entries.description: map location name where the last item was picked up; returns tp_name_someplace when no item has been picked up.

entries.name: tp_powerups
entries.description: $colored_powerups or $colored_short_powerups, depending on value of tp_poweruptextstyle

entries.name: triggermatch
entries.description: full text of the console message that last fired a regexp trigger.

entries.name: weapon
entries.description: name of the currently active weapon, using tp_name_* cvar values (e.g. "rl", "lg").

entries.name: weaponnum
entries.description: currently active weapon as a slot number (1-8), or pre-selected best weapon number when cl_weaponpreselect is enabled.

entries.name: weapons
entries.description: separator-delimited list of all weapons currently held, ordered from strongest to weakest (lg, rl, gl, sng, ng, ssg, sg, axe).
